regions.finding: Organic Syntheses hazardous-chemical handling notice and publisher material only. No reaction arrow, table, procedure, condition, yield, failure result, or chemistry figure appears on this page.

unresolved: None for reaction extraction; page 1 is safety and publisher guidance only.

regions.region: page 2 title, author/checker block, and two-arrow reaction scheme
regions.finding: The original page shows the current Organic Syntheses preparation, not prior literature: arrow A converts protected propargyl ether 1 and cyclohexanecarboxaldehyde with (S)-α,α-diphenylprolinol/ZnBr2 in toluene at 130 °C to (R)-2; arrow B uses TBAF·3H2O in THF from 0 °C to room temperature to give (R)-3. These arrows map to two successive experimental records rather than one duplicated scheme record.

regions.region: page 2 lower half, beginning of Procedure A
regions.finding: Procedure A begins with the 500-mL apparatus, 17.3 g/76.6 mmol ZnBr2, argon transfer, and vacuum/heat-gun drying. This cross-page procedure supports the first full-scale A record and the explicitly stated second full-scale repetition reported later in Note 19.

unresolved: The scheme does not give a separate single-stage yield for either arrow; the procedure text and notes supply a crude A mass and combined A+B yields.

regions.region: page 3 upper half, continuation of Procedure A
regions.finding: The original page provides exact full-scale reactant quantities, the 5 min pre-stir, 150+50+8 mL toluene additions, 1 min aldehyde addition, 3 min preheat stir, argon/Dean–Stark setup, 130 °C for 11 h, precipitate handling, concentration, chromatography, and 20.8 g crude (R)-2 outcome.

The original page gives 20.80 g crude (R)-2, 200 mL THF, 32.0 g/101 mmol TBAF·3H2O, ice-bath-to-room-temperature operation, 2 h, exact workup and chromatography, and 9.42 g (R)-3 in 62% combined A+B yield with 99% ee.

unresolved: Procedure A has no isolated yield and Procedure B has no separate single-stage yield; the 62% value explicitly spans both steps.

regions.finding: Apparatus drying, stir-bar dimensions, ZnBr2 storage/transfer/form, Dean–Stark dimensions/wrapping, and the need for efficient stirring were inspected and linked as operating/material context to Procedure A; they do not define separate experiments.

Reagent/solvent purities, suppliers, toluene distillation under argon, and cyclohexanecarboxaldehyde distillation were checked. These facts support the existing A/B records and are not independent reactions.

unresolved: Supplier and bulk-material specifications do not establish batch-specific assay values beyond those explicitly printed.

regions.finding: Compound 1 may be purchased or prepared from propargyl alcohol and TBSCl according to Radha's cited procedure. The cited precursor reaction is classified as a prior-literature example; the submitters' 68–74 °C/20 mmHg distillation, Na2SO4 drying ratio, and storage guidance are retained without claiming that this route supplied the main batch.

The crucial 5 min pre-stir, TLC Rf values for 1/2/3, vigorous-boil-to-reflux observation, approximately 2 mL water collection, and color changes were linked to Procedures A/B rather than treated as separate reactions.

CHCl3/CH2Br2 crude-NMR assay gives a 64–69% yield range across different A runs; the range remains aggregate and is not assigned to a specific isolated batch. The imine-removal rationale, vacuum handling, 300 g silica and exact 2.4 L petroleum ether/60 mL ether eluent were linked to Procedure A.

unresolved: The note does not state whether commercial or prepared compound 1 was used for the reported main run; the cited precursor reaction lacks its experimental conditions and yield.

regions.region: page 6 upper half, continuation of Notes 15–19
regions.finding: The original page completes the Procedure-A chromatography/characterization context; gives the exact 390 g silica and two petroleum-ether/ethyl-acetate eluent stages for Procedure B; confirms 9.42 g product, 99% GC purity, yield basis on limiting (S)-α,α-diphenylprolinol, and a distinct second full-scale A+B run giving 9.82 g/65%.

regions.region: page 6 lower half, Note 20 and Scheme 1
regions.finding: A separate racemic control preparation begins here for ee determination. The four visible operations are CuBr/4 Å sieves/toluene at 25 °C, copper removal, ZnI2/NaI in toluene at 110 °C, and TBAF·3H2O in THF from 0 °C to room temperature. The continuation on page 7 was used only as necessary text context; page 7 is not claimed as covered.
